entities.summary: Lloyd Goodrich was an American art historian. He wrote extensively on American artists, including Edward Hopper, Thomas Eakins, Winslow Homer, Raphael Soyer and Reginald Marsh. He was associated with the Whitney Museum of American Art in New York City for many years. Lloyd Goodrich was a architects & designers from New Jersey (1897, New Jersey–1987-03-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
